experiment: Pretrained Pythia14M to three independent two-layer diffusion blocks: feasibility pilot
frozen_shared_parameters: Original input embedding and output head frozen in both fine-tuned methods; all six original layers trainable. Diffusion adds per-block final norms and zero-output time-conditioning MLPs. No parameters shared between trainable blocks.
data: Official WikiText2 raw train/validation/test, each LF-preserved line independently BPE tokenized, no special tokens. Heldout from adaptation only, pretraining contamination unknown.
training: AdamW lr3e-4 betas(.9,.95),weight_decay.01,clip1,warmup12,constant thereafter. Same random train windows per paired seed. Diffusion cycles blocks0,1,2, inverse-CDF truncated-lognormal sigma within equal-probability interval; perexample weightedCE ((sigma²+1/128)/(sigma²/128))/512.
conversion: Fresh start from original pretrained weights for each run. No distillation, no cross-block gradients, clean raw embeddings plus scaled/preconditioned unit-L2 noisy target embeddings; concat clean/noisy streams and strict clean-past-only attention.
inference: Two log-spaced Euler steps in each of3 noise ranges followed by final block at sigma=.002:7 denoiser calls,14 layer applications,2x sequence. Start noise at80. Posterior-mean unit-L2 target embedding from softmax; negative Euler dt.
evaluation: 64 disjoint uniformly spaced test windows,32 validation,32 tokens/window,score final16 targets. Converted decoder log score from arithmetic4-particle mixture of final softmax probabilities, fixed target-free particles. This is finite-decoder NLL, NOT exact implicit-diffusion perplexity or ELBO. Normal model exact truncated-context nexttoken NLL.
matching: Paired96 updates equal observed data (6144tokens); additionally save converted first step reaching normal96 cumulative measuredCPU, potentially below96 or after96,cap384. One-step timing overshoot disclosed. Warmup2 forwardbackward passes WITHOUT optimizer update excluded from budget, evaluation excluded.
compute: Scratch CPU one thread; no rentals or production changes. Each method process capped600CPU seconds.
selection: No tuning or selecting using test; all3 seeds and both endpoints reported. Validation diagnostic only. No large-model claims.
